nodes.title: Verdict: Legitimate. The flagged transaction of $125.08 online was consistent with the cardholder's profile, as evidenced by a case-memory model score of 0.007, indicating it did not resemble confirmed fraud cases from July to October. The bank risk score was 0.52, which is below the threshold for initiating further investigation. The transaction was within the card's usual range and the cardholder passed the step-up challenge. No shared origin was detected, and the device profile was new for this account. The final actions recommended were ALLOW_TRANSACTION (auto), CREATE_CASE (auto), and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD (auto).
